MXH10-60Z (SMC compact slide, bore 10, stroke 60) - STAND-IN for MXH2 10-60 (MXH-Z is discontinued).
Source: TraceParts, catalog "Motion" (Motion Industries SKU 06714549), downloaded 2026-11-22. STEP AP214.
Differences to MXH2 10-60 (catalog MXH p.31 vs MXH2 p.13, bore 10 / stroke 60): table length LT 99 vs 104 (+5),
table standoff 6 vs 6.5 (+0.5), table tap depth 6 vs 6.5. Section 20 x 46, body 106.5, ports M5 and hole pattern are identical.
Use as is for now; lengthen the table by 5 mm for MXH2 when the model is revised.
